# proxmox_storage (Data Source)

Fetches details of a single Proxmox VE storage pool from `/storage/{storage}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_storage" "local_lvm" {
  storage = "local-lvm"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `storage` (String) The storage identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Allowed content types.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the storage is disabled.
- `id` (String) Storage identifier.
- `nodes` (String) Nodes this storage applies to.
- `path` (String) File system path (for dir type).
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the storage is shared.
- `type` (String) Storage type.
